Moving to Texas from California and worried about HOA fees and rules? 🏡 

In this video, we break down the truth about Texas HOAs (homeowners association) versus California HOAs—what they cost, how they’re enforced, and why they might actually work in your favor!

In Texas, many new homes come with HOA (homeowners association) that are far more affordable—often $200–$600 per year—and focus on basics like lawn care, exterior appearance, parking, pets, and protecting neighborhood standards. Compared to California, Texas HOA (homeowners association) are typically less restrictive, more community-driven, and designed to protect your new home investment, not micromanage your life.

Learn how Texas HOA (homeowners association) can protect property values, keep neighborhoods looking great, and how to find homes in Temple, Belton, and Central Texas that fit your lifestyle. Don’t automatically rule out HOA homes—they might be exactly what you need!

Thinking about moving to Texas from California? Watch this video to get the real scoop on Texas HOA (homeowners association) and make your move stress-free!
